## Quickstart

**1. Install the CLI**

```sh
npm i -g mint
```

**2. Create a docs site**

```sh
mint new my-docs
cd my-docs
```

**3. Preview it locally**

```sh
mint dev
```

Your site opens at [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) and reloads as you edit.

**4. Ship it**

Push the folder to GitHub and [connect the repository](https://app.mintlify.com) in the dashboard. Every push to your default branch deploys.

> **Requirements:** Node.js 20.17 or later. LTS versions are recommended; Node 25 is not supported.

<br />

## Commands

### Write and preview

| Command        | What it does                                 |
| -------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `mint new`     | Scaffold a new docs site                     |
| `mint dev`     | Preview locally with live reload             |
| `mint format`  | Format your MDX files                        |
| `mint og`      | Render a page's social preview image         |
| `mint migrate` | Guide a migration from another docs platform |

### Check

| Command             | What it does                                     |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `mint validate`     | Content, OpenAPI, and strict build checks for CI |
| `mint broken-links` | Find broken links, anchors, and redirects        |
| `mint a11y`         | Check color contrast and alt text                |
| `mint score`        | Check how agent-ready a live docs site is        |

### Publish

| Command                    | What it does                                |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `mint add-domain <domain>` | Add a custom domain and get its DNS records |
| `mint export`              | Export a static zip for air-gapped hosting  |

### Insights and automation

| Command            | What it does                                         |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `mint analytics`   | Query views, searches, feedback, and assistant chats |
| `mint automations` | Create, list, and delete automations                 |

### AI agents

| Command             | What it does                                               |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mint agent setup`  | Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to Mintlify          |
| `mint instructions` | Print Mintlify workflow instructions for agents            |
| `mint deploy`       | Provision a site with no account and get push instructions |
| `mint claim`        | Move a `mint deploy` site into a Mintlify account          |

### Account and CLI

| Command                         | What it does                                         |
| ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `mint signup` / `mint login`    | Create an account or sign in from the browser        |
| `mint status` / `mint logout`   | See who you're signed in as, or sign out             |
| `mint config set <key> <value>` | Save defaults like `subdomain`, `dateFrom`, `dateTo` |
| `mint update`                   | Update the CLI to the latest version                 |
| `mint version`                  | Print the CLI and client versions                    |

Run `mint <command> --help` for every flag, or read the [full command reference](https://mintlify.com/docs/cli/commands).

<br />

## Command details

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint dev</code></b> &nbsp;Local preview</summary>
<br />

Run from the folder that contains your `docs.json`.

```sh
mint dev
mint dev --port 3333 --no-open
mint dev --groups admin beta
```

| Flag                  | Description                                             | Default |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--port <number>`     | Port for the preview. Tries the next free port if taken | `3000`  |
| `--no-open`           | Don't open the browser                                  |         |
| `--host`              | Expose the preview on your local network                |         |
| `--groups <group...>` | Preview as readers in these user groups                 |         |
| `--signed-in`         | Preview as a signed-in reader with no groups            |         |
| `--disable-openapi`   | Skip OpenAPI processing for faster startup              |         |
| `--disable-prefetch`  | Turn off navigation prefetching on very large sites     |         |
| `--multi-repo`        | Compose docs from several local repositories            |         |

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint validate</code></b> &nbsp;One check for CI</summary>
<br />

Runs content rules and OpenAPI checks, then a strict build. Exits `0` when clean, `1` on errors, and `2` if validation couldn't run.

```sh
mint validate
mint validate --no-build --format json
mint validate --files "guides/**/*.mdx" --fix
```

| Flag                  | Description                                               |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--files <glob...>`   | Limit page checks to these files or globs                 |
| `--no-build`          | Skip the strict build for a fast, offline check           |
| `--fix`               | Apply available fixes and check again                     |
| `--disable <rules>`   | Turn off rules or groups, for example `--disable openapi` |
| `--enable <rules>`    | Turn rules back on, for example after `--disable all`     |
| `--format json`       | Print a single JSON report for scripts and agents         |
| `--groups <group...>` | Validate as readers in these user groups                  |

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint broken-links</code></b> &nbsp;Link checker</summary>
<br />

```sh
mint broken-links
mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-external
mint broken-links --links-to /guides/setup
```

| Flag                | Description                                               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--files <glob...>` | Only check these files or globs                           |
| `--check-anchors`   | Also check `#section` links against heading slugs         |
| `--check-external`  | Also check external URLs                                  |
| `--check-snippets`  | Also check links inside `<Snippet>` components            |
| `--check-redirects` | Also check that `docs.json` redirects point to real pages |
| `--links-to <page>` | List every internal link that points to a page instead    |

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint og</code></b> &nbsp;Social preview images</summary>
<br />

Renders a page's OG image with the same code as your live site, using the `thumbnails` settings in `docs.json`.

```sh
mint og guides/webhooks
mint og --preset headline --surface brand
mint og --output og.png --no-open
```

| Flag                  | Description                                   |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `--preset <name>`     | Try a preset without editing `docs.json`      |
| `--surface <name>`    | Try a surface without editing `docs.json`     |
| `--appearance <name>` | Try an appearance without editing `docs.json` |
| `--output <path>`     | Where to write the PNG                        |
| `--no-open`           | Don't open the image after rendering          |

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint analytics</code></b> &nbsp;Docs analytics in your terminal</summary>
<br />

Requires `mint login` and a Pro or Enterprise plan.

```sh
mint analytics stats --from 2026-01-01
mint analytics search --format graph
mint analytics feedback --type page --format json
mint analytics conversation list
```

Every subcommand accepts `--subdomain`, `--from`, `--to`, and `--format <table|plain|json|graph>`.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint export</code></b> &nbsp;Air-gapped hosting</summary>
<br />

```sh
mint export
mint export --output docs.zip --base-path /docs
```

| Flag                  | Description                            | Default      |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `--output <path>`     | Output zip file                        | `export.zip` |
| `--base-path <path>`  | Path prefix the export is served under |              |
| `--groups <group...>` | Export as readers in these user groups |              |
| `--disable-openapi`   | Skip OpenAPI file generation           |              |

The zip includes a `serve.js` server and a `README.md` with the rules for hosting it yourself.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b><code>mint agent setup</code></b> &nbsp;Skills and MCP for coding agents</summary>
<br />

Installs [Mintlify skills](https://mintlify.com/docs/ai/skillmd) and configures the [Admin MCP](https://mintlify.com/docs/ai/mintlify-mcp) for Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. Requires Node.js 22.20 or later.

```sh
mint agent setup
mint agent setup --agent claude-code codex cursor
mint agent setup --agent codex --global
```

Setup applies to the current project by default; `--global` configures your user account. After setup, finish the OAuth sign-in inside each agent.

</details>

<br />

## Run checks in CI

```yaml
name: Docs
on: pull_request

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: npx mint validate
      - run: npx mint broken-links --check-anchors
```

<br />

## Troubleshooting

If `mint dev` isn't working, try these in order:

1. Run it from the folder that contains your `docs.json`.
2. Run `mint update` to get the latest CLI.
3. Check that you're on Node.js 20.17 or later, and not Node 25.
4. Delete the contents of the `~/.mintlify` folder and run `mint dev` again.

Still stuck? Ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/mintlify/discussions).
